MonsterSource.Name: Monster & NPC source
MonsterSource.Hint: Where the creatures placed on imported scenes come from. Official compendiums uses the Wizards of the Coast compendiums installed in the world first (NPC Token Replacer's selection when active), then the creatures Plutonium already imported with the adventure. Plutonium uses Plutonium's creatures first and imports them from 5etools with the dynamic ring.

Edition.Name: Rules edition
Edition.Hint: Which statblocks to use for monsters and NPCs. 2024 picks the most recently published 2024 statblock (Monster Manual 2024, SRD 5.2…), following renames such as Goblin → Goblin Warrior; 2014 uses the original ones. Creatures with no statblock in the chosen edition use the other.

Fallback.Name: Fall back to the other source
Fallback.Hint: If a creature is not found in the chosen source, try the other one (Plutonium must be active).

DynamicRing.Name: Dynamic token ring
DynamicRing.Hint: Enable the token dynamic ring on the creatures this module imports, from official compendiums or through Plutonium.

AutoPopulate.Name: Place creatures on scene import
AutoPopulate.Hint: When a scene with DDB creature data is created (e.g. by the Plutonium map importer), place its monsters and NPCs automatically. Otherwise use the scene's context menu.

ChapterFolders.Name: Chapter folders
ChapterFolders.Hint: Files imported scenes, player versions included, into Book › Chapter folders in reading order, like DDB Importer. Run DDBPlutoniumScenes.organizeAll() in the console to file scenes imported earlier.

Notify.NoData: This scene has no DDB creature data.
Notify.AlreadyPopulated: This scene was already populated. Use the scene's context menu to place the creatures again.
Notify.NoPlutonium: Plutonium is not active: using official compendiums.
Notify.Queue: Placing DDB creatures on {count} imported scenes, one at a time…
Notify.PlutoniumWarmup: Plutonium is preparing its compendium cache for the first creature import of this session. This can take a minute or two; creatures will keep appearing on the scene.
Notify.NothingToMerge: No duplicate creatures to merge: every creature in the module's folder is unique.
Notify.Merged: Merged {actors} duplicate creatures into Plutonium's actors; {tokens} tokens moved.
